clues: This city sits in hill country, where a river winds past lakes, springs, and falls. The land lifts and dips in low hills all through the town.
Summers here are long and very hot, and winters are short and mild. Yet a sudden cold burst, called a Blue Norther, can strike fast.
In 1839, the young republic sent a team to seek a site for a fresh capital. They chose this river spot, and a planned town was born.
The world's largest city bat colony lives under a bridge in this city. Mother bats raise their pups there from mid-summer to fall.
Texas laws are made in the capitol in this city. The governor of the state works here too.
